mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_workbench_review(batch_id,review_type,run_id,schedule_fingerprint,material_fingerprint,operator_id,created_at) SELECT #{targetBatchId},review_type,#{targetRunId},schedule_fingerprint,material_fingerprint,operator_id,created_at FROM mrp_workbench_review r WHERE r.batch_id=#{sourceBatchId} AND r.review_type IN ('SCHEDULE','MATERIAL') AND r.id=(SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM mrp_workbench_review x WHERE x.batch_id=#{sourceBatchId} AND x.review_type=r.review_type)
